desc: Derive algebraic expressions for all in-degrees in terms of binary orientation variables for cycle and hub edges.
Characterize equivalence classes of orientations that produce identical in-degree sequences, including hub degree.
Reduce the count to the number of forests using the Tutte-polynomial/forest identity.
Develop an O(N) five-state connectivity DP for counting forests, including boundary initialization and cycle closure.
Implement and validate the O(N), O(1)-memory solution; it passed both public sample tests.
